text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Haa... haa...!
I'll win...! I'll win, win, win...—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(More, even more overwhelmingly...!
Pull away, strongly, fiercely... to the very end――)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: The strongest is me...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ghaaaaaaa...hh!!
The cheers from the crowd grew louder along with Duramente's acceleration. But if she kept going like that, she would...—

“—She screamed.
Amidst the roaring cheers, with all her heart and soul.”

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ――...Haaaaaaah!

The moment Duramente crossed the finish line—
no, even before that, a thunderous roar filled the stands.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
S... She's strong!
So strong...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—To be this strong!
Claiming victory in this year's Satsuki Sho...!
It's Duramente!!”
(Uwoooooah!!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-What was that running style...!
No way... That's impossible...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's not just a matter of being fast.
She's simply way too strong...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
So this is Duramente...
—The culmination of the strongest bloodline...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Alright...!!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
W-What is up with that girl...!
She's way too strong...!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
To contest the crown against a monster like that...?
From now on too...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
So this is Duramente-san's strength.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
OK, I admit it.
My spine is shivering... but this is a shiver of excitement before battle.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Faced with an overwhelmingly powerful rival, how should we prepare?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm raring to go! Come on, let's devise a strategy!
...I won't let anyone take the Nippon Derby!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Incredible, Dura-san.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Captivating everyone's hearts through sheer power...
There's that kind of strength, too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"It stings, but...
She's so cool!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...I gotta give it my all too!
Alright, time to train!"

Duramente delivered a breathtaking victory.
When she returned, her expression seemed
somehow radiant and serene—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Y-Your... voice.
Isn't it completely hoarse?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Your voice
definitely reached me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
Why you, too?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not following.
choice_data_list: What got through was your feelings, I'm sure.

text_block_list.text: In truth, just as Duramente had doubted, it is difficult for a single voice to pierce through the roaring cheers of 50,000 spectators and the thunder of the race itself.
So if she heard a voice... it's thanks to her believing it would reach, holding onto those feelings in her heart.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I see, I'm...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You truly believed that...
they would make their voice heard, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Taking today's reflections into account,
I want to come up with a new menu."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Will you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'll go change.
By speaking to Duramente, she was able to turn her awareness outward. However, there was no telling how long that would remain effective.
choice_data_list: (I need to think of a more fundamental solution—)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Just a little more.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer's voice opened the door for me.
But in the end, I'm the one who has to change.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(I can't run an overwhelming, perfect race like this.
Before the next one—)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (Before that race... the one I've yearned and longed for...!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
By the time the Nippon Derby arrives—
I will secure a flawless victory, without fail...!
